nom: Charlotte Tilbury Magic Cream Anti-Aging Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report mixed results: one found the rich texture too heavy and developed burning and tingling on her neck and cheeks, and another with an oily nose still needed to layer an oil-control primer on top, though one with oily/combination skin uses it successfully as a rich night cream.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some who call it severe or eczema-prone, overwhelmingly report it relieves flaking and tightness and leaves skin soft and hydrated, though one longtime user says a recent reformulation left her waking up with dry skin again.
segments.combination: Most reviewers with combination skin report good hydration and a plush, non-greasy finish, but one with oily-combination skin found her skin felt drier wearing it than going without, especially in winter.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no breakouts or itching, but one reviewer whose skin is sometimes sensitive broke out badly days after use, and her partner, who isn't sensitive or acne-prone, had the same reaction to the same jar.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature or over 40, including one in her 50s, report it leaves their skin softer, less dry and firmer, though results on visibly reducing fine lines specifically are described as modest by at least one reviewer.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother, firmer-looking skin and visibly softened fine lines with continued use, including improvement around the eyes, but at least one reviewer says she hasn't seen drastic results on her fine lines despite liking how the cream feels.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe strong, immediate hydration and plumper-looking skin, but two reviewers report the opposite: one felt drier wearing it than without it, and a longtime user says a recent reformulation left her waking up with dry skin instead of the bounce she used to get.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness or rosacea report the cream calms their skin without irritation and, in one case, visibly reduced redness over time.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the cream helped with fine lines and some discoloration, and another with acne scarring says her scars were fading and improving after a couple of weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who are acne-prone, report no new breakouts, and one longtime user says a reformulation fixed the breakouts she used to get from the original version; however, one reviewer reports breaking out badly days after use, a reaction her non-acne-prone partner had too when testing the same jar.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the finish as non-greasy to semi-matte overall, but one reviewer with an oily nose says she still needs to layer an oil-control primer on top when using it under makeup.

aspects.libelle: Rich, luxurious texture that melts in
Small jar, pricey for the amount you get
Jar packaging less hygienic than a pump
Reformulation reduced breakouts versus the original

extraits.texte: This used to be my favorite moisturizer, and it was the only skincare item I spent this much money on. The product arrived and after I began using it, I noticed my skin was....not bouncing back like it usually does. I would wake up with dry skin. Then I noticed the label on the bottom has changed from "instant turnaround moisturizer" to now say "immediate skin revival". This prompted me to search if it had changed. I no longer have the original outer packaging, so I cannot return it. It simply isn't working for me, and it cost a lot for somebody like me. I am disappointed this change was not made clear.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was sent this product in exchange for my honest review, I used the product several times, and to be honest, I was kind of disappointed with this product. I had high expectations because it was a luxury brand that I've used previously and had good experiences with, and supposed to be premium quality, however the product made my face break out every time I used it. It felt really nice and smooth going on, and gave my skin a powdery kind of feeling. I liked that, but then a couple days later my skin would start breaking out really bad. My skin tends to be sensitive sometimes, so I asked my fiance to try the product as well, and she does not have sensitive skin, and she also had that experience. Her skin broke out after using with several small white heads, and she isn't very acne prone. Overall this product would probably be okay if you were older, and beyond the phase where you get acne whatsoever, but for me, and my fiance as well, this just wasn't a hit.

I really wanted to like this product, but it just didn't work for me. I don't know if it didn't mesh well with my skin or my foundation, but I almost felt like my skin felt dryer wearing this than without it. To me it also smelled like ponds and I couldn't get past that. I passed it along to my mother in law and she seemed to like it okay, so it's not a terrible product, just not for me. (I have oily combo skin for reference, but currently dry during the winter). I did receive this free for my honest review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a fantastic primer for dryer skin. It feels like it should be too heavy under foundation, but somehow it just makes the foundation look like skin. If you have oily skin, you might not have the same experience. My nose is very oily and I've found that I still need to put a bit of oil control primer on top of this cream. As a face cream, this is good, but not so good that I'd replace my current regime. It does do an excellent job of locking in moisture, but it wasn't mind blowing. So I'll continue to use my regular night creams and save this as a makeup primer. My only complaint is that it's not a particularly good value, the container is very small for the price and you do need to use a good dab to cover your face. Also it smells exactly like Ponds cold cream.

I've used Charlotte Tilbury's products in the past and always been obsessed. Anything with this company never fails me. I've use Magic cream on the daily but with this new formulated version I'm so so obsessed and will be using this one in its place. This moisturizer does amazing on my skin. My skin is left feeling silky and soft, with a radiant glow. It has a slight rose scent to it but is tolerable. Although I do prefer face products to be fragrance free it's not overbearing or harsh on the skin. I have not seen drastic results in reducing fine lines. I definitely recommend making the purchase, and will again for my self. No side effects from this moisturizer accept that it leaves my skin looking great.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm very pleased with Charlotte tilbury Magic Cream Anti-Aging Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid! The before and after photos tell the story. I have mature, dry skin and I love the way the Magic Cream made my face feel softer and less dry. The fragrance is amazing, made me feel like I was at the beach.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Charlotte's Magic Cream feels super silky and rich, but not greasy at all. It sinks in really fast, which I love. I have rosacea and it didn't irritate my skin one bit. I've been using it at night, and I wake up with my skin feeling hydrated and looking glowy.
